post.originalText:
Same prompt. $8.89 on one end, $0.33 on the other.

The prompt: build an AI bill calculator with an over-the-top receipt animation. Each one ended its demo with a receipt for its own run.

GPT-6 Astra: $8.89
Claude Fable 5.2: $7.72
Claude Opus 5.5: $5.69
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: $0.33

The new Fable cost more than Opus on fewer tokens. DeepSeek took an hour and still sent the smallest bill, for the fifth straight episode.

Same prompt, four bills #5
